title: Church Accountability
definition: Church Accountability is the loving responsibility believers have to encourage, correct, restore, and watch over one another under Christ.
summary: Church Accountability is the loving responsibility believers have to help one another walk faithfully with Christ.
christFocus: Jesus Christ shepherds His people through His Word, His Spirit, and the loving ministry of the body.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
Church accountability is the loving responsibility believers have to help one another follow Christ faithfully. Scripture does not picture discipleship as private and untouchable, but as life together under the Word.

Accountability is not control, surveillance, or spiritual superiority. It is truthful love that warns, encourages, restores, and bears burdens for the sake of another's soul.

Jesus shepherds His people through His Word, His Spirit, and His body. Healthy accountability reflects His care rather than human domination.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: This matters because isolated believers are more easily deceived, hardened, or overwhelmed. It also corrects abusive forms of accountability by insisting that correction must serve restoration, humility, and obedience to Christ.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Invite trusted believers to speak truth into your life, and be willing to do the same with gentleness. Address sin directly but humbly, aiming for healing and faithfulness rather than shame or control.
